amasrakalesi.name: Amasra Castle
amasrakalesi.slogan: A fortress on a thin peninsula, with the Black Sea on both sides.
amasrakalesi.line: Romans raised it, Byzantines walled it, and Genoese added the front walls and gates in the 14th and 15th centuries.

cincihan.name: Cinci Han
cincihan.slogan: Camel-train courtyard in the middle of the bazaar.
cincihan.line: The han carries no inscription, so its date is unknown; tradition credits Cinci Hoca, the judge executed in 1648.

hormakanyonu.name: Horma Canyon
hormakanyonu.slogan: A wooden path pinned to the cliffs of the Küre Mountains.
hormakanyonu.line: A wooden walkway of about 3 kilometres, fixed to the rock, now lets visitors walk the canyon.

incekayasukemeri.name: Incekaya Aqueduct
incekayasukemeri.slogan: Water crossing the Tokatlı Canyon on a stone thread.
incekayasukemeri.line: About 116 metres long and 60 metres above the canyon floor, it was restored in the 1790s by Grand Vizier Izzet Mehmet Pasha, a Safranbolu native.

hidirliktepesi.name: Safranbolu Old Town
hidirliktepesi.slogan: A valley of timbered Ottoman houses, best seen as the sun goes down.
hidirliktepesi.line: Safranbolu joined the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1994 for its intact Ottoman town of some 1,000 listed buildings.
